children: Bank7 entered into a First Amendment to its Stock Purchase Agreement with the court-appointed receiver for Century Financial Services to acquire approximately 71% of Century for $88.96 million. The amendment follows a court-supervised auction on September 3, 2026, where Bank7 submitted a $91.0 million winning bid that included a $2.04 million break-up fee credit. Closing remains subject to a court sale order and regulatory approvals, including from the Federal Reserve. The transaction would give Bank7 a controlling stake in Century.
